raw: Our Promoters will continue to hold majority control of our Company after the Issue. Upon the completion of the Issue, our Promoters will hold 54.54% of the post-issue shareholding of our Company. As a result of this majority shareholding, our Promoters will have the ability to exercise significant control over the management and operations of our Company, as well as over all matters requiring approval by shareholders. This concentration of ownership may have the effect of delaying, preventing or deterring a change in control of our Company, and could potentially influence the voting outcomes of corporate actions and resolutions in a manner that may not align with the interests of other shareholders.
